Container.Name: nafa-console
Container.Overview: NAFA Operations Console: read-only dashboard over the live trading ledger (holdings, orders, P&L, Sharia compliance, health). LAN or Tailscale only — never forward this port to the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Bind it to the LAN or tailscale0 address only.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Read model (console.db) and the ledger clone (repo/).

Config.Name: Ledger repository
Config.Description: HTTPS URL of your ledger repository. Cloned into /data/repo on first start, then pulled every minute.

Config.Name: Ledger branch
Config.Description: The branch the live workflows commit to.

Config.Name: Pull interval (s)
Config.Description: How often the indexer pulls the ledger.

Config.Name: Role
Config.Description: owner or viewer. Login and 2FA arrive with milestone M1.
